title: SNP Genotyping and ApoE Genotyping
author: Huw Morris
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.by9ypz7w

steps.title: Collect Blood Samples
steps.instruction: Collect a 4 mL blood sample in an ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid (EDTA) vacutainer for DNA extraction.

steps.title: Extract DNA
steps.instruction: Perform DNA extraction on the collected blood samples.

steps.title: Genotype DNA Samples
steps.instruction: Genotype DNA samples using the Illumina HumanCore Exome array with custom content following manufacturers instructions.

steps.title: Perform Initial Quality Control
steps.instruction: Perform standard quality control procedures in PLINK v1.9.

steps.title: Filter Individuals and Variants
steps.instruction: Remove individuals and variants based on the following quality criteria:

substeps.instruction: Remove individuals with low overall genotyping rates (< 0.1) and heterozygosity outliers (> 2 SDs away from the mean).
Remove individuals whose clinically reported biological sex does not match the genetically determined sex.
Remove individuals who are > 6 SDs away from the mean of any of the first 10 principal components.
Remove variants with a low genotyping rate (< 99%), Hardy-Weinberg Equilibrium p-value < 1 x 10-5, and minor allele frequency < 1%.

steps.title: Impute Genotypes
steps.instruction: Input genotypes separately to the 1,000 Genomes Project reference panel (phase 3 release 5) using the Michigan Imputation Server.

steps.title: Lift Over and Generate Principal Components
steps.instruction: Lift over data to genome build hg38 and generate genetic principal components.

substeps.instruction: Lift over data to genome build hg38 using liftOver.
Generate twenty genetic principal components from a linkage-pruned SNP set (removing SNPs with an r2 > 0.02 in a 1000kb sliding window shifting 10 SNPs at a time).
Remove extreme outliers according to the first 5 principal components (> 6 SDs away from the mean).

steps.title: Filter Imputation Quality
steps.instruction: Retain only variants with imputation quality >0.8 to keep high quality calls for merging across cohorts.

steps.title: Recalculate Principal Components
steps.instruction: Recalculate genetic principal components after removing outliers to avoid calculation bias.

substeps.instruction: Exclude additional outliers who are > 6 SDs away from the mean of any of the first 5 principal components.
Include the first 5 new principal components as covariates in future GWAS to adjust for population substructure.

steps.title: Perform APOE Genotyping
steps.instruction: Restrict genotyping of APOE to samples and SNPs that survived the QC procedures, focusing on two common SNPs of the APOE gene: 388 T > C (rs429358) and 526C > T (rs7412).

substeps.instruction: Determine the three haplotypes: ɛ2(388 T–526 T), ɛ3(388 T-526C), and ɛ4(388C-526C).
Determine the six genotypes: ɛ2/ɛ2, ɛ2/ɛ3, ɛ2/ɛ4, ɛ3/ɛ3, ɛ3/ɛ4, and ɛ4/ɛ4.
Use these to determine ɛ4 status in each sample.
